concerns.text: T039 (Remove synthetic fallback) is ordered AFTER T010-T017 (Data Pipeline). T039 must precede T010. If T010 runs before T039 is implemented, the pipeline may inadvertently generate synthetic data or fail to 'fail loudly' on missing real data, violating the 'Real Data Only' constraint before the safeguard exists.

T010-T017 are all marked [P] (parallel) but target the same file `code/preprocessing.py` and represent a strict sequential data flow (Download -> Filter -> ICA -> Epoch -> Validate). The 'Single-File Parallelism' note admits this risk but the task list does not enforce the required sequential execution order or modularization strategy, creating a high risk of merge conflicts and race conditions in artifact generation.

T014 (Sample size validation) and T033 (Underpowered scenarios) are listed as separate tasks in Phase 3 and Phase 5 respectively. T014 already implements the 'HALT if <100' logic. T033 duplicates this logic in a later phase. T033 should be removed or redefined as a reporting task only, as the data flow halts at T014, making T033 unreachable in the normal execution path.

T018 description mentions 'beta and low-gamma' bands, while the spec and FR-005 restrict the range to 8-30 Hz (alpha/beta). While this is a scope error, it also creates a dependency ambiguity: if T018 computes gamma, downstream tasks (T020-T023) expecting only alpha/beta features may fail or require filtering logic not specified in the task order.
